statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 4, low, because CME equity index futures have been halted since Friday at 21:00Z and nineteen of the twenty-four hours published here contain no tradable interval at all; only the five slots from the scheduled 22:00Z Sunday reopen onward are tradable, and they carry conditional Tail readings of 12, 13, 12, 11 and 10 that stay far below the block threshold. Stress is 36, moderate: the 50% US tariff on Canadian goods is in force after trade talks collapsed, Canada has dated a dollar-for-dollar match to 8 September, the Treasury secretary has scheduled a Monday press conference detailing an unprecedented economic-isolation plan for Iran, the 20 August H.15 column shows 4.19% at two years, 4.69% at ten and 5.23% at thirty, and energy has completed a second consecutive weekly gain above 5%. Confidence is 87, high: Friday's closing levels, yields, oil, volatility and the week-ahead calendar were each verified against primary sources this run, and the only missing input is a live price path, which no venue can supply until the reopen.
recommendation: The last observed session remains consistent with functioning mean reversion rather than a one-way path: cash NDX opened at 29,359.60, traded down to 29,142.44, recovered to 29,405.12 and closed at 29,308.86, up 0.33% on the day and below its own open, ending a five-day losing streak, while the VIX settled at 14.89 near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range. Both session extremes were retraced and neither produced repeated extension after a failed pullback, so no Tail amplifier carries over from observed structure. Friday internals were split rather than aligned, with software firm and semiconductors net lower, which withholds the cross-asset alignment that a Tail escalation would require. The elevated conditional readings in this assessment are confined to the reopen band from 22:00Z Sunday to 02:00Z Monday, which is the only reason a danger window is published at all; every hour before it describes a shut venue, and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON across the entire horizon.
headline: Closed-venue assessment with five reopen hours inside the horizon: Tail holds the floor of 4 through nineteen shut hours, then carries conditional readings of 12, 13, 12, 11 and 10 from the 22:00Z Sunday reopen, while live US tariffs on Canadian goods, a Monday Iran economic-isolation announcement, a post-2007 long end and a second week of energy gains stay unpriced.
body: CME Globex equity index futures stopped trading for the week on Friday at 21:00Z and are scheduled to reopen on Sunday at 22:00Z. The twenty-four slots published here run from 2026-08-23T03:00:00Z to 2026-08-24T02:00:00Z, so the reopen slot and the first four hours after it all sit inside the horizon. Cash NDX settled at 29,308.86 on Friday, up 0.33% from a 29,213.17 prior close, after opening at 29,359.60 and printing a 29,142.44 low and a 29,405.12 high; both extremes were retraced inside the session, the close finished below the open, and the day ended a five-day losing streak even as the Nasdaq lost about 2% on the week in a Treasury-led selloff. The VIX settled at 14.89, down 6.0%, near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range. On policy, the 50% US tariff on Canadian goods is in force after trade talks collapsed, and Prime Minister Carney has said Canada will match it dollar for dollar from 8 September across steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp, paper and electronics. Newly verified this run: the Treasury secretary has scheduled a Monday press conference to detail an economic-isolation plan for Iran covering exchange houses, ship registries and oil smuggling routes alongside the existing port blockade, which is why Stress holds at 36 rather than easing to the 35 that the previous hour projected. On rates, the 20 August H.15 column shows two years at 4.19%, ten years at 4.69% and thirty years at 5.23%, the highest since 2007, with Friday's closes quoted near 4.73% and 5.27% after the week's rise. Energy completed a second consecutive weekly gain above 5%, with Brent at $94.39 and WTI at $87.06. Bitcoin's 22% weekly advance to about $77,011 ran counter to the equity tape and is noted as context only. The shared cross-asset context read this run was fresh, complete and internally consistent with Friday's tape: index futures modestly higher, the volatility future lower, Treasury futures lower across the curve and gold up 2.39%, with megacaps five to three higher on a Tesla-led mean and semiconductors net lower. None of that is live price-path evidence, and none of it establishes the persistent directional efficiency that Tail measures. Stress at 36 reflects a substantial stack of unpriced inputs that must be expressed in a single opening auction; Tail at 4 reflects the simple fact that a shut venue cannot produce a pathological price path. Conditional Tail rises only after the reopen, peaking at 13 in the first full hour, which is why the danger window covers 22:00Z Sunday through 02:00Z Monday and nothing wider.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past 24 hours is nearly complete: 21 hourly assessments are available, while the 05:00Z, 06:00Z and 21:00Z clock-hours on 22 August have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. Across every available hour Tail held 4 and the mapped policy state stayed EA_ON, so no hour approached the block threshold and the dominant mode remained normal throughout. Stress traced a shallow arc: 36 at the start of the window, a build to 42 through the middle of Saturday as the tariff deadline passed and the Canadian response was dated, then a steady easing to 36 by the final hour. Confidence stayed in an 85-88 band, reflecting verified closing levels and macro data set against the absence of any live price path. Nothing in the window contains observed one-way structure, because no venue was open to produce it.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 4 because CME equity index futures are confirmed halted and no Nasdaq-100 price path can develop inside this slot. The following eighteen slots describe the same closed market, so Tail holds 4 and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON throughout them. The last five slots are tradable: the 22:00Z scheduled reopen carries a conditional Tail of 12, the first full hour after it a conditional 13, the hour coinciding with the Monday Tokyo cash open a conditional 12, and the final two slots a conditional 11 and 10, all still green and all resting on gap and thin-liquidity scenarios rather than on observed structure. They are the only reason a narrow danger window is published. Stress eases from 36 to a 34 trough through the Sunday overnight hours, rebuilds steadily to 47 in the final closed hour, peaks at 53 in the reopen slot as the weekend information set converges on a single opening auction, then eases to 44 as Asian liquidity arrives. Confidence declines from 87 to 71 across the horizon, which reflects distance from the assessment cutoff rather than any defect in the verified inputs.
